description: OpenStreetMap is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Africa GeoPortal. This web map references the live tiled map service from the OpenStreetMap project. OpenStreetMap (OSM) is an open collaborative project to create a free editable map of the world. Volunteers gather location data using GPS, local knowledge, and other free sources of information such as free satellite imagery, and upload it. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher Africa GeoPortal. Its tags are basemap, world, Open Street Map, OSM, OpenStreetMap. The portal shows 2020-06-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
